rubrics.name: Findable
rubrics.rationale: PID present (scheme: DOI); PID resolved; deposited in a sustainable repository (Zenodo); that the PID resolves to a specific VERSION of the dataset is not verified — confirm before accepting (the gate requires a 2 here)

rubrics.name: Accessible
rubrics.rationale: metadata fetchable via PID lookup but no standard-vocabulary references found

rubrics.name: Interoperable
rubrics.rationale: metadata is JSON-LD but references no standard vocabulary; 1 machine-readable schema entities

rubrics.name: Reusable
rubrics.rationale: machine-readable license linked in the metadata (Apache-2.0); no AI/ML prohibition language found in license or use terms

rubrics.name: Transparent
rubrics.rationale: source data linked from the root in a structured field (isBasedOn / prov:wasDerivedFrom); no per-file provenance or ground-truth entities — consider 2 if the link names the exact source artifact

rubrics.name: Traceable
rubrics.rationale: processing steps described in prose only (Preprocessing, Annotation); no machine-readable transformation steps — score 0 if the prose is too thin to trace a sequence of steps

rubrics.name: Interpretable
rubrics.rationale: no software entities in the crate

rubrics.name: Key actors identified
rubrics.rationale: 0 of 2 authors carry a PID; 2 named in free text only

rubrics.name: Semantics
rubrics.rationale: abstract and keywords present, no controlled-vocabulary terms

rubrics.name: Standards
rubrics.rationale: 1 schema entities but no standard-vocabulary binding found

rubrics.name: Data documentation template
rubrics.rationale: no human-readable datasheet; 8 of 9 machine-readable sections populated

rubrics.name: Fit for purpose
rubrics.rationale: appropriate and inappropriate uses both stated; 1 prior publications linked

rubrics.name: Secure
rubrics.rationale: sensitivity stated in prose (rai:personalSensitiveInformation), not a standard security label; score 0 if the statement does not say whether protection is required

rubrics.name: Persistent
rubrics.rationale: PID present (scheme: DOI); recognized archive(s): Zenodo; an explicit retention commitment is assumed for recognized repositories, not verified; note the criterion covers RAW/unprocessed data — confirm the raw data itself is what's archived

rubrics.name: Standardized
rubrics.rationale: formal schema/standard declared, so structural validation is possible; no populated standard-vocabulary bindings — semantic conformance cannot be deterministically validated (the 1-rule)

rubrics.name: Contextualized
rubrics.rationale: some context present but incomplete (example data or withheld-information description missing)

note: Only criteria with an automated estimate are counted; the rest need human or model judgment and are listed in unestimated_criteria.
